decisions.decision: spec.completed emits only from the context-file watcher via a status-extended TransitionCache
decisions.why: the three completion paths never converge in TypeScript (the Companion terminal step writes completed from Python), so the context file watcher is the only seam all three flow through, and cache diffing makes double-fires structurally impossible
decisions.rejected: emitting inside setStatus plus a second watcher emit for the Python path — two emit sites needing cross-de-duplication is exactly what FR-013 forbids

decisions.decision: adopt FR-016 by seeding the form-minted telemetryInstanceId through the creation preamble; watcher emits spec.created only for id-less non-sample contexts
decisions.why: the persisted id is a reliable form-vs-terminal discriminator AND fixes the broken created-to-completed funnel join (the form id is never persisted today, later events mint a different id)
decisions.rejected: keeping the documented blind spot — marginal cost fell to one preamble line once the id mechanism existed

decisions.decision: one shared buildWorkflowChoices in workflowManager; delete the spec-editor private builder and the dead selectWorkflow quick-pick; retire workflow.selected
decisions.why: the two builders demonstrably diverge (Companion gating, validation, dedupe) and the picker has no live entry point; the Create Spec form IS the picker after this feature
decisions.rejected: patching both builders to agree (keeps two derivations of one fact) or wiring the quick-pick to a command (redundant surface)

decisions.decision: sample ships at assets/sample-spec/ with a sampleSpec marker and is seeded via workspace.fs.copy overwrite:false; seeding emits sample.opened, never spec.created
decisions.why: specs/** is excluded from the vsix and demo fixtures are mutation-prone; the marker keeps the seeded sample from polluting the creation rung the sample exists to feed
decisions.rejected: dist/resources (no build step produces it — known silent no-op landmine) and read-in-place (forbidden by the spec)

decisions.decision: spec.completed emits only from the context-file watcher, via a status-extended TransitionCache with seed-then-diff
decisions.why: the three completion paths never converge in TypeScript (the Companion terminal step writes completed from Python), so the context file is the one artifact all three mutate; cache diffing makes a double-fire structurally impossible and also de-duplicates the two watchers that can route the same file
decisions.rejected: emitting inside setStatus plus a second watcher emit for the Python path — two emit sites needing cross-de-duplication is exactly what FR-013 forbids

decisions.decision: buildWorkflowChoices returns choice metadata (description, installed, entryCommand) and the spec editor only formats commands on top of it
decisions.why: FR-007 needs one list producer, but the editor still owns provider-specific command formatting; splitting at the metadata boundary keeps one derivation of what is offerable without pushing provider concerns into the workflows module
decisions.rejected: having the builder return fully provider-formatted entries (couples the workflows module to the active provider) or keeping the private builder and syncing the two (two derivations of one fact)

decisions.decision: the spec editor records and reports the EFFECTIVE post-install-modal workflow, not the raw form pick
decisions.why: a Companion pick the user downgraded through the install-first modal actually runs stock, so seeding and reporting the effective value keeps the on-disk record, the dispatched command family, and the created event agreeing on one workflow
decisions.rejected: attributing the raw pre-modal form value — it would report Companion for specs that ran stock and break the created-to-dispatched join by workflow

decisions.decision: run-in-flight ships at 880px / 12fps / lossy 45 instead of the house 960px / 14fps / lossy 30
decisions.why: at 36 seconds it is the longest clip in the set and the standard encode landed at 4.6MB, over the 4MB README target; the step-down reaches 3.7MB with no visible artifacts at README width
decisions.rejected: shortening the clip (the spec pins 30 to 60 seconds) or shipping it over the size target

plan.summary: Full plan + research + data model + telemetry/UI contracts: merged welcome with bundled-sample seeding, radio-card workflow choice on one shared builder, five funnel rungs with a single watcher-based completed seam, PostHog-side dashboard split, pipeline-built launch content.
plan.key_finding: The three completed-writers never converge in TypeScript (the Companion terminal step writes from Python), so the context-file watcher is the only viable single seam — and the form-minted specInstanceId is never persisted today, meaning created-to-completed could not be joined per spec until the preamble seeds the id.
